events.title: Steam Next Fest Demo — LIVE NOW!

events.title: Play the Demo before Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone, we have an exciting announcement today!As you might know, we will be participating in the Steam Next Fest, but you won't have to wait until the Next Fest starts! We are opening the gates on October 12th for everyone.Our Next Fest demo will be playable between October 12th - October 26th, so you will be able to start playing a week before the Next Fest starts - that means you will be able to parkour around for more!Demo StartsDemo EndsOctober 12thOctober 26th Check out the Demo page

events.title: The Rifted Skies | Coming Fall 2026
events.summary: The Rift is coming. A long-abandoned world. A deadly, chasing Rift. High-octane physical parkour. Can your home ever be saved? Mark your calendars, The Rifted Skies coming this Fall on Steam! Watch the reveal trailer below.In The Rifted Skies, your movement skills are key.
